This section will list peer-reviewed publications and manuscripts, with each entry identified by its actual status.

### Peer-Reviewed Publications

Published work will appear here with full citations, DOIs, and links where available.

### Manuscripts

Manuscripts will be listed with accurate status labels, such as *in preparation*, *submitted*, or *under review*, and with appropriate coauthor approval.
